title: Red beans and rice
ingredients: 1 lb dried red kidney beans, soaked, or 3 cans, drained
12 oz andouille or smoked sausage, sliced
1 onion, 1 green pepper, 2 celery stalks, chopped
steps: Brown sausage. Add trinity vegetables and garlic; cook until soft.
Add beans, spices, and liquid. Simmer until creamy, 1 1/2–2 hours for dried (30 minutes for canned, mash some beans).
Season. Serve over rice with hot sauce.
